signature: A peaceful complex of sky-blue, cream and rarely red painted rooms and corridors, cracked and peeling, floored in thick yellow sand that keeps decades of children's footprints, holes, castles and toys, lit only by beams of sunlight-like glow from nowhere while rain falls on a roof you cannot see.

exits.to_label: The originally intended level (not specified on the page)
exits.label: Opened a door (or climbed through a window) in the room with no sand
exits.source_quote: will send the wanderer to the level they would have entered originally
exits.hint: Look for the one room where the floor is bare. Its door, or its window, should take you where you were going.

entity_policy: NONE. 'Devoid of entities, it is peaceful here' (survival class 0). No NPC, threat, hazard, food, water or working light.
notes: SOURCE: complex of corridors and rooms, most floors under thick yellow sand; walls blue, cream and rarer red, cracked and peeling to plaster or corroded steel; all ceiling fixtures dead; beams of sunlight-like glow from arbitrary ceiling and wall spots light most rooms; dry, constant 15 C; perpetual soothing rain heard from the ceiling with no water anywhere; ceiling backed by impenetrable voidstone; devoid of entities; children's toys embedded in the sand (shovels, buckets, toy cars, dolls); occasional deteriorated furniture; no wind or water so marks persist (children's footprints, small-hand patterns, dug holes, sandcastle attempts, toy-car tracks); rooms regenerate only over decades; exit by a door in a room with no sand or through a window, to the level originally intended. TESTIMONY: arrivals in 'some sandy corridor'; digging and searching for toys (Darren Joubert letter); the 'Playlist for Exploring Liminality' photographs. ADAPTATION: a seeded 6 x 5 grid of 9 m cells (spanning tree plus short loops), some cells corridors with 2.95 m ceilings; floor levels 0.54 m apart joined by three sand-covered steps (the page states no storeys; natural variation only); windows between unjoined rooms; outer doorways choked with sand to the lintel as the diegetic boundary (finite window of a complex that continues); beams are additive light shafts with warm light anchors at their pools; your own prints are a bounded 1200-instance ring kept until the level reloads; nine dig spots each yield one toy and leave a hole; the voidstone appears in one room where the plaster was broken; the exit's destination is not specified (EXT release boundary) and is offered on both the door and the window of the unique sand-free room. SOURCE L008>L075#4 supplies the from_L008 arrival (in the starting corridor). No regeneration during a visit.
